title: routes.json of a piece
description: The route each role of a piece runs on (<run>/<item>/routes.json), by role; rewritten when a fallback or a retry changes a route.

model.description: Model id, null when the provider picks.

transport.description: Transport of the role (stream-json, text, acp, ...).

timeout_s.description: Wall limit of the role; 0 when none.

idle_timeout_s.description: Silence limit of the role; 0 when none.

resume_argv.description: Command line that continues a session of the role.

env.description: Environment of the role kept by an older run; never shown.
